prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one original AI illustration for an interactive expanding screen about Langya grass weaving in Tancheng, Linyi, Shandong.

Show an invented pair of pale straw-woven slippers resting on a small flat woven mat, evoking everyday grass-woven articles. The flat fibrous ribbons are narrow, light straw-gold and cream, with a few muted soft-blue woven accents. The objects and pattern are fictional, not a copy of a real maker's work or an actual historical object; they must not be treated as evidence of the exact material or method.
Composition: place both small slippers and the central woven texture in the middle 30–35% of a wide horizontal composition, so the object and texture remain recognizable in the centered narrow crop of an accordion panel. Add a few abstract pale reeds at the edge and a quiet matte paper background; no basket, no woody willow rods and no large looping rope-braid landscape. Elegant tactile paper-and-fiber collage, natural oat, cream, washed indigo, subtle warm grey; original and different from a willow basket scene.
Constraints: no people, hands, feet, weaving action, tools, authentic process, named artist, text, characters, numbers, logos, signatures, seals, watermark, border or interface.
